text: {"label":"Autism Intervention Outcomes and Program Evaluation","definition":"Evaluations of behavioral treatment programs for autistic children, especially early intensive behavioral intervention, examining short- and long-term outcomes, comparative effectiveness, sustainability, and delivery by parents, schools, and community providers.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on how well whole treatment programs work, unlike neighbours on autistic people's social and adult needs, specific reinforcement and repetitive-behavior procedures, or the scope and advocacy of the field."}
